fields.label: Status
fields.description: Included means the charge was genuinely incurred and is deliberately not invoiced - a medication absorbed by the medical boarding rate. It is NOT Cancelled: the medication was given, the row is its dispensing record, and its rate is the true cost the inclusive rate absorbed.

fields.description: Which dose this order is for. Only needed when the medication offers more than one dose option - with a single option the dispense resolves it on its own, and with none the medication does not deduct stock at all.
fields.label: Dose Option

fields.description: Where the goods leave from. Boarding is a distinct place with its own branch, so a stay must be able to name its own store rather than silently drawing on the clinic's. Left blank, the dispense falls back to the Medication's default warehouse and then to Stock Settings.
fields.label: Warehouse
Dosage
fields.description: The clinical dose as written, free text: "0.5 cc", "1 tablet", "5 mg/kg". NOT dose_option - that names a Medication Dose Option and drives the stock deduction, this is what the vet wrote for the human giving it. Either can exist without the other.

fields.label: Frequency
fields.description: How often, free text: "BID", "every 8h", "once daily". No controlled vocabulary - the visit path accepts free text and clinics write frequencies in Arabic and English.

fields.label: Duration (Days)
fields.description: How many whole days the course runs. Clinical only: it does NOT multiply qty, rate or amount. The dose count stays in qty exactly as the client sends it.

fields.label: Scheduled Datetime
fields.description: When this order is due to happen. Optional, and never defaulted - an absent value means 'do it now', which is most orders. A stamp written automatically would be indistinguishable from one a person chose, and nothing could then tell a scheduled order from an unscheduled one.
Stock units actually issued for this row, in the Item's own Stock UOM. Zero unless the medication has a dose option.
fields.label: Stock Issued Qty

fields.description: The most recent Stock Entry this row issued or returned.
